motion.name: independent-ghost
motion.value: Horizontal oscillation, vertical bobbing, rigid rotation and lower-cloth flutter
motion.purpose: Provide visible character motion while retaining facial geometry and continuous translucent cloth.

motion.name: sky-bats
motion.value: Seven viewport-traversing bat silhouettes with separate wing phases
motion.purpose: Supply secondary character motion above the clearing.

motion.name: default-rate
motion.purpose: One host-controlled requestAnimationFrame clock clamped to 1-60 FPS; pause, hidden document, speed zero and reduced motion freeze the scene.

narrative.overview: This record applies only to Hollow Lantern. An original friendly ghost floats through a violet moonlit clearing beneath a crooked manor, with warm carved pumpkins and autumn foliage. The independent transparent character supplies visible motion while the painted background keeps its composition and texture.
keyCharacteristics: Original friendly eerie Halloween imagery without gore.
Independent floating ghost and animated flying bats.

rules.name: The Rigid Face Rule
rules.body: Keep the ghost face and upper cloth rigid. Compose lower-cloth flutter on integer offscreen rows before rotating the complete character, avoiding overlapping translucent strip bands.

rules.name: The Clearing Flight Rule
rules.body: Cover-crop the background independently while ghost and bats follow viewport paths. Keep the ghost near the center on portrait screens and retain its complete silhouette.

dos: Do keep ghost motion independent of bats, mist, leaves and pumpkin glow.
Do preserve the original prompts and artwork provenance.
Do honor pause, visibility, reduced motion and host frame-rate changes.
donts: Don't distort the ghost face or introduce cloth strip banding.
Don't add gore, franchise characters, logos or a HUD.
Don't present generated-asset provenance as legal clearance.
